title: H. G. Wells: The War of the Worlds — Ep 18/27 — "The Fifth Cylinder"
description:
The War of the Worlds, Episode 18. Book Two opens under the black smoke. The narrator and the shaken curate leave the ruined road at Sunbury — ash on every hedge, a dead horse in its shafts — and press east past Richmond, where red masses float beneath the bridge and the town burns on its hill.

Near Kew a Martian fighting-machine rises over the roofs and hunts little black figures across a meadow. They drop into a ditch, creep on by night past burned guns, and find a deserted house at Sheen stocked with bread and drink.

Then a blinding green glare, a concussion like nothing on earth, and the ceiling comes down upon them. When the narrator wakes, the curate is bathing his head — and beyond the broken wall a metallic rattle says the fifth cylinder has fallen on the house. "God have mercy upon us!"

Chapter I of Book Two of H. G. Wells's The War of the Worlds (1898), "Under Foot", in the public domain.

— The Keeper's Lantern —
Every episode is one whole chapter, in order, from the first page to the last.
